messages.content: Hi! How can I help you today?

Hi there, I’ve been going through my rewards statements and something doesn’t seem right with my cash back. Could you help me figure out what’s going on?

I have both a Gold Rewards Card and an EcoCard, and lately the cash back I’m seeing doesn’t seem to add up, but I’m not sure which transactions are off. I don’t have my phone on me to pull up statements right now, so I’m hoping you can take a look on your side and help me identify any discrepancies.

{"message":"I can help — because this requires accessing your account I need to verify your identity first. Please provide any two of the following account-linked details: (1) date of birth (MM/DD/YYYY), (2) email address on the account, (3) phone number on the account, or (4) mailing address. You can either give your email (or your full name — case-sensitive) plus one other item, or two of the other fields. Which two would you like to provide? If you prefer not to share them here, I can explain how to check in the secure portal or, if you’d like, transfer you to a human agent."}

Sure — I can provide my date of birth and phone number.

- Date of birth: 11/03/1990  
- Phone number: 312-555-0481

{"message":"Thanks — I can proceed. To complete identity verification I need to look up your account in our system. Please provide either your full name (case-sensitive), the email address on the account, or your user ID. I’ll use that to retrieve your account and confirm the two items you already provided (date of birth and phone number). After verification I’ll log the verification and review cashback on your Gold Rewards Card and EcoCard. \n\nAlso — do you want me to check a specific date range (for example: last 30 days, last 90 days, or a custom range)? If not, I’ll start with the last 90 days."}

I can provide my full name: **Priya Sharma**.

And yes, starting with the **last 90 days** works for me.
